title: 航空グローバル演習
subtitle: Special Practice in Global Aviation
educationalGoal: Students are expected to participate in the Boeing Externship Program to understand international trends in the aviation industry. Students will survey problems and trends in the aviation industry as a team and make presentations that propose solutions. Through this experience, students will consider their future career.
advice: In this course, students will participate in the Boeing Externship Program. Students will attend five Boeing presentations and study international trends in the aviation industry. Students will use the Boeing presentations to conduct surveys of problems in the aviation industry, identify future trends, and propose solutions in a presentation document. Students will prepare for a final presentation to Boeing representatives. In addition, as part of the preparation, students will rehearse their presentations with university staff. English ability is essential because lectures are conducted in English; thus, students are required to participate in extracurricular Aviation English seminars. The course schedule can change according to the Boeing Externship Program (including changes in the lecture periods). The course comprises lectures and Boeing presentations with discussion and group activity.
requiredKnowledge: Students are required to have sufficient knowledge of aviation and aeronautical engineering. Because the Boeing presentation is conducted in English and students need to prepare an English presentation, English ability is essential.

activityGoals.body: Be able to describe the current state of the world's aviation industry, including Boeing.
Be able to understand Boeing presentations and discuss them in English.
Be able to survey the problems and future trends of aviation industry and also prepare for English presentation
